item.subject: science
item.stem: Meera's school in Pune keeps a small garden pond with fish, water plants, snails and stones at the bottom. The pond stays healthy for years without anyone cleaning it. Which statement best explains how the pond keeps its balance?

options.A: The fish alone keep the pond balanced because they eat all the waste.
options.B: Plants make food, animals eat plants or other animals, decomposers return nutrients to the water and soil, and the water, sunlight and stones support all of them together.
options.C: The pond stays balanced only because animals and plants are present in the same place.
options.D: The non-living parts like water and stones do not play any role in the balance.
